cold_start.description: Worker pool not pre-warmed; first request after idle period
cold_start.mitigation: Pre-warm worker pools during off-peak (non-blocking optimization)

shadow_concurrency.description: Multiple simultaneous Pi shadow requests competing for pool slots
shadow_concurrency.mitigation: Increase Pi shadow pool slots (non-blocking optimization)

repository_query.description: Vector similarity search on large embedding index
repository_query.mitigation: Add vector retrieval cache layer (non-blocking optimization)

legacy_wait.description: Pi correlated shadow waiting on legacy path completion before starting
legacy_wait.mitigation: Architectural concern; acceptable at shadow stage

network.description: Network jitter to external financial data sources
network.mitigation: Circuit breaker / timeout already in place

auth.description: JWT validation on cold auth principal cache

db_checkout.description: Transient DB connection checkout delay under load spike
db_checkout.mitigation: Pool size already configured correctly; transient event

unknown.description: No clear root cause identified from available diagnostics

comparison_to_p116a.note: Despite larger K1-K5 volume, rate of >4800ms cases improved from 2.15% (P1.16A) to 1.57% (P1.17). Consistent root cause distribution.

note: Tail latency root causes consistent with P1.16A analysis. Rate improvement observed at 25% volume. All three optimization opportunities remain non-blocking for P1.17 completion.
